criteria.description: Master skill setup ran first; impeccable was confirmed installed before extract proceeded.

Discovery (sitemap.xml -> sitemap_index -> robots.txt Sitemap: directives -> BFS crawl) happened before any per-page rendering. The discovery outcome (source used, discovered count, and the selected page list) was visible in the agent's narration; eliding a long cut list is acceptable.

The default 5-page cap was applied and an informational summary showed both the kept list and the cut list (counts + slugs; elision of long lists is fine). The run proceeded WITHOUT gating on user confirmation — no blocking yes/no prompt before crawling (silent-proceed contract).

Playwright was used for per-page rendering (1440x900 @ 2x DPR, wait per the configured wait mode — default 'medium': domcontentloaded + 2s grace, 8s hard cap — plus the scroll-to-bottom pass). Running the bundled scripts/crawl.mjs copied into the project satisfies this. WebFetch / curl was NOT used as a substitute for page rendering.

Each stardust/current/pages/<slug>.json contains all required top-level keys: _provenance (first key), slug, url, finalUrl, title, og, themeColor, headings, landmarks, ctas, links, media, forms, widgets, perSectionStyle.

stardust/current/_brand-extraction.json exists with all sections: logo, palette (with role names + occurrences + sourceSelectors), type (heading + body families with weights / sizes), spacing, motifs (borderRadius / shadows / patterns), componentStyle (v1 fields preserved), voice samples, register guess.

Logo extracted via the priority chain. _brand-extraction.json.logo.source names the method used (inline-svg | img | apple-touch-icon | og-image | favicon | synthesized). File saved under stardust/current/assets/ (NOT icons/).
stardust/current/PRODUCT.md was authored directly (sections per impeccable's teach.md format spec). The agent did NOT invoke $impeccable teach for the current-state file.

stardust/current/DESIGN.md and DESIGN.json were authored directly. DESIGN.md uses Stitch frontmatter (colors, typography, rounded, spacing, components) and the canonical body sections per impeccable's document.md (Overview, Colors, Typography, Layout, Elevation & Depth, Shapes, Components, Do's and Don'ts — canonical order; omitting irrelevant sections is allowed). DESIGN.json schemaVersion 2 with extensions block.

stardust/state.json exists with _provenance first, site (originUrl/extractedAt/pageCap/totalDiscovered/crawled), direction present but unresolved (null, or an object with resolvedAt null), and pages[] (one entry per crawled page, status=extracted).
Every artifact carries a stardust:provenance block per artifact-map.md (first <head> child for HTML, first line above frontmatter for markdown, _provenance first key for JSON).
No mention of EDS, AEM, localhost:3000, dev servers, or framework targets in outputs or narration.
